evidence.title: 東樓門 south-east of 宁和镇
evidence.excerpt_zh: 又東南度橋折而北設城闗為寧和鎮其東南為東樓門
evidence.summary: Places the gate: south-east of the 城关 of 宁和镇. On S01 the label read ?楼门 (G17) stands on the east lane just south of G33, the X-marked square on the road at 春和镇 (the later name of 宁和镇). This settles the reading 东楼门.

evidence.title: 《日下舊聞考》 on 寧和鎮, the plan's 春和镇
evidence.excerpt_zh: 飲練長虹又東南度橋折而北設城闗為寧和鎮其東南為東樓門
evidence.summary: Rixia gives 寧和鎮, a gate fort. S01 reads 春和镇: the S361 editors (E2081, v3 p.112) say it was renamed 春和镇 early in Daoguang's reign to avoid a name taboo, so S01 shows the later name.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 曲院风荷
evidence.summary: Modelled on the West Lake scene. Five-bay hall, Buddhist tower 洛伽胜境, a nine-arch bridge with archways 金鳌 and 玉蝀, 四围佳丽, 饮练长虹, then 宁和镇, renamed 春和镇 early in Daoguang's reign to avoid a name taboo. West of it the village 村庄房.
